title: Orchestration & A2A
description: Agent-to-agent topology — who delegates to whom, the live delegation flows, and declared cadences. Reads of the communication graph are privileged and self-audited.

graph.title: Communication graph
graph.description: Delegation and MCP topology, derived from observed signals. Supervisors anchor the top tier; workers and MCP peers sit below.
graph.truncated: Showing the first {{n}} edges — raise the limit for more.

empty.title: No communication observed
empty.description: No delegation or MCP edges are in the observed window. This is what is seen, not all that exists — read the coverage note above.

flows.title: Delegation flows
flows.description: Supervisor → workers clusters. State is derived at read-time from recency; stalled means the supervisor has an active schedule that is overdue.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.description: Declared cadences for agents and swarms. Health reflects the observed cadence against the expected interval — a missed fire reads as stalled, never hidden.
schedules.emptyHint: Declare a cron, event or manual cadence to track whether a subject actually fires on time.

form.createDescription: Declare a governed cadence for an agent or swarm. New schedules start active.
form.editDescription: Retarget the subject or cadence. Identity and trigger fields are immutable.
form.name: Name

cadenceHint.cron: Opaque cron cadence text. Syntax is interpreted only by the configured dispatcher.
cadenceHint.event: Opaque event reference or cadence text.
cadenceHint.manual: Optional opaque note for this manual schedule.

form.expectedIntervalHint: Used to detect a missed cron cadence.
form.graceFactorHint: Multiplier applied before the cadence is marked missed.

errors.intervalRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
errors.intervalCronOnly: Expected interval is available only for cron triggers.
errors.graceRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

status.pauseDescription: {{name}} will remain declared but will no longer be expected to fire.
status.resumeDescription: {{name}} will become active and cadence monitoring will resume.
status.retireDescription: {{name}} will be permanently retired and can no longer be fired.

fire.title: Fire {{name}}
fire.description: A governed fire requires an approval bound to the current plan before dispatch.
fire.step1Description: Open a governance approval for this exact subject and cadence.
fire.copyFailed: Approval reference could not be copied
fire.step2Description: After the approval is allowed, submit its reference to dispatch the plan.
fire.executeFailed: Approved fire could not be executed

decisions.title: Decision ledger
decisions.description: Append-only record of fire decisions for the selected schedule. A decision is shown exactly as it resolved — an approval is not an actuation.
decisions.pickHint: Select a schedule to see its decision ledger.

opStatus.skipped: Skipped (an earlier step failed or was denied)

decisions.estateCaveat: The estate ledger, newest first. It is the only view in the console that shows the full ledger row for a workflow run — audit, findings and the run detail may show related facts, but not this record.
decisions.truncated: Showing the most recent {{count}} decisions and the engine reports more: this list is TRUNCATED. Read it as a sample, not as the whole ledger.
decisions.estateDescription: Append-only record of every decision in the estate, most recent first. Includes decisions that belong to no schedule.
decisions.forbidden: Your role cannot read schedule decisions.

timeline.title: Activity timeline
timeline.description: Recent communication events for the subject.

history.title: Revision history — {{name}}
history.description: Chronological, append-only snapshots of this schedule.
history.scopeCaption: Restore re-applies only mutable fields — never name, subject kind, or trigger kind.
history.selectTwo: Select two revisions to compare their snapshots.
history.restoreDescription: Restore the selected mutable schedule fields for {{name}}?

flows.title: No delegation flows observed yet
flows.description: A flow appears once observed runtime signals record a delegation edge from a supervisor session to a worker.

schedules.title: No schedules declared yet
schedules.description: Declare a cron, event or manual cadence for an agent or swarm to track its desired state and observed health.
